What's new in Vekrun 0.5.7 — Big test suites

• A project whose tests take longer than 15 minutes can be verified now. Every test run (before the agent, after each turn, the verification and the proof) used to stop at 15 minutes, so a big suite failed every check however good the work. When a project's tests run out of time, Vekrun now doubles that project's limit (up to 30 minutes), remembers it, and says so; you can also set it under Settings → Factory.
• Tickets from a Markdown file: Board → Tickets → Manage → Tickets from Markdown → Upload a Markdown file (or drop it in). Every ticket in it becomes a ticket on the Board, no repository needed; uploading the same file again updates them.
• Ticket fields written as **Goal**: text (colon after the bold) are read too; before, only **Goal:** text was, and such tickets lost their goal, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
• Cloud model cards (OpenRouter, xAI) match the coding agents': a short summary, details folded away, and Connect opens a dialog for your key.
